Interface Typeahead<B>

Type Parameters:
B - the builder type for method chaining
All Known Implementing Classes:
FilterInputGroupTypeahead, MultiSelectTypeahead, SearchInputGroupTypeahead, SingleSelectTypeahead
public interface Typeahead<B>
Interface for components that combine a text input with a menu to provide typeahead/autocomplete behavior. A typeahead component filters or refreshes its menu items based on user input.

The typeahead behavior is driven by a RefreshStrategy that evaluates each input change and returns a Decision:

  • Decision.refresh() — re-query the server immediately
  • Decision.debounce(int) — re-query the server after a debounce timeout
  • Decision.filter() — filter existing items locally (default when no strategy is set)
  • Decision.keep() — do nothing, keep the current menu state as-is
